hypothesis: Fine-output site intervals may reduce per-thread imbalance on the NUMA-derived teams; extra SIMD tails, range calls and locality effects may offset the benefit. End-to-end full12 decides.
conclusion: No demonstrated stable end-to-end acceleration in this bounded A/B/A comparison.
interpretation: Candidate is between the two controls. Its approximately 0.20% reduction relative to their mean is much smaller than the approximately 5.84% control drift. Neither a stable speedup nor a general regression is established. Do not attribute the entire drift to a particular hardware or OS cause without measurements.
